title: Ashbury Rewards Training Note: Reduction for Late Folio Corrections
content:
A folio correction that reaches an Ashbury Rewards account long after the stay takes back fewer points.

**What is the late-correction reduction?**
The computed reversal — the points to be taken back on the spend a folio correction removed — is reduced by a late-correction reduction of fifty percent when the correction date is more than ninety calendar days after the stay's actual check-out date, of twenty-five percent when it is thirty-one to ninety days after, and of nothing when it is thirty days or fewer after; the reduced reversal is rounded down to a whole point.

**Which dates are compared?**
The correction date is the posted date of the adjustment on the folio; the actual check-out date is read from the stay's Room Reservations record. The days are calendar days from the actual check-out date to the correction date.

**What are the bands?**

| Calendar days from actual check-out to the correction date | Late-correction reduction |
|---|---|
| 30 or fewer | None |
| 31 to 90 | 25 percent |
| More than 90 | 50 percent |

**Where do the boundaries fall? (hypothetical check-out on 1 March 2026)**

| Correction date | Days after check-out | Reduction |
|---|---|---|
| 31 March 2026 | 30 | None |
| 1 April 2026 | 31 | 25 percent |
| 30 May 2026 | 90 | 25 percent |
| 31 May 2026 | 91 | 50 percent |

**How is the reduced reversal rounded? (hypothetical figures)**
A computed reversal of 1501 points with a 25 percent reduction is 1501 multiplied by 75 and divided by 100, which is 1125.75, rounded down to 1125.
